title: Approval Matrix
description: Authorization levels and financial thresholds that govern who may approve capital expenditure at each amount.

levels.description: Approval tiers ordered by ascending authority. Thresholds should form a contiguous, non-overlapping range.

level.description: Authorization level; higher numbers denote greater authority. Referenced by asset-request.approvals[].level.

minAmount.description: Inclusive lower bound of the amount this level may approve.

maxAmount.description: Inclusive upper bound. Omit for an unbounded top tier.

requiresQuorum.description: Number of approvers required at this level (e.g. board vote).

escalationRole.description: Role the request escalates to on rejection or timeout.
